entry.title: New: Bill 116 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, REVENUES; CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS, DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION, WAILUKU-KAHULUI COMMUNITY PLAN AREA; AND APPENDIX C, DEPARTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION, WAILUKU-KAHULUI COMMUNITY PLAN AREA" The purpose of this bill is to 1) increase Carryover/Savings in the General Fund and Total Estimated Revenues by $300,000; 2) amend Capital Improvement Projects, Department of Parks and Recreation, Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan Area, Parks and Recreation, General Fund, by adding a new line item entitled "Keopuolani Field Lights Replacement" in the amount of $300,000; and 3) amend Appendix C, Department of Parks and Recreation, Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan Area, by adding a new project and project description for "Keopuolani Field Lights Replacement" in the amount of $300,000.
